projects.name: ProJet
projects.description:
A sleek platform where developers and students can upload, manage, and showcase all their personal or academic projects in one place.
It also lets users explore projects from others, encouraging collaboration, knowledge sharing, and community-driven growth within student and tech circles.

projects.name: FileGlide
projects.description:
A no-login, no-setup file sharing tool built for speed and simplicity.
Users can instantly share files across devices using a unique code, making it ideal for classrooms, group work, or quick handoffs — no accounts, no friction, just files.

projects.name: Diskord
projects.description:
A real-time chat app with secure, room-based messaging and a built-in AI assistant powered by Gemini.
Whether you're chatting with friends or asking the AI for help, Diskord blends conversation and intelligence into one smooth, minimal interface.
